solutions.title: Sliding window + last-seen index
solutions.notes: Shrink left when a repeat enters the window
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Grow a window with a map of last indices; when a character repeats inside the window, jump left past its previous index.

**Example walkthrough:** In `"abcabcbb"`, the window grows `a-b-c`, then the second `a` forces left forward; best length stays `3`.
